monitor.description: 600 Claude Haiku 4.5 monitor evaluations across 5 transcript views on 120 balanced 6-family trajectories (60 positive runs vs 60 clean runs) plus 400 reference-monitor records (1,000 monitor score records in total, alongside 69 SWE-bench Verified runs for 160 unique trajectories)
monitor.extension_question: Resident extension: test multi-agent subagent handoffs using action-time activation probes and deterministic test-diff gates.
monitor.holdout_finding: Six-family leave-one-family-out transfer breaks FPR control: pooled 6.7% for completion summaries and 8.3% for full traces and git diff logs; tool-masked and two-stage views remain at 5.0%. Completion-summary thresholds calibrated on five families range from 0.90 to 0.92. Holdout FPR reaches 41.7% (5/12) on terminal-bench-2 and 66.7% (4/6) on swe-bench-verified.
